articles.headline: Mohamed Salah finally writes World Cup history with Egypt - can he salvage his international legacy?
articles.description: Mohamed Salah has achieved more in the sport than any other Egyptian player in history, gracing the upper echelons of the game with Liverpool, winning silverware aplenty at Anfield, and establishing himself as a global superstar.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Emotional Neymar inspired by Lewis Hamilton; USMNT in action
articles.description: We continue the final round of group stage matches at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with the USMNT and Germany among the teams in action.

articles.headline: Neymar: 'Really nervous' on Brazil return after 981 days
articles.description: Neymar admitted he was "really nervous" when he ran onto the field and played for Brazil for the first time in 981 days.

articles.headline: Aubrey Modiba: Canada must beware of Bafana 'upset' despite 'home' advantage
articles.description: South Africa's Aubrey Modiba is quietly confident that Bafana Bafana can add to the World Cup's growing list of surprise results when they face Canada in their Last 32 match in Inglewood on Sunday.

articles.headline: Jürgen Klopp shrugs off question about Bastian Schweinsteiger's remarks on Ivory Coast's play style
articles.description: Jürgen Klopp broke off an interview after being asked about former Germany player Bastian Schweinsteiger's characterisations about the Ivory Coast's team's style of play.

articles.headline: Anti-gay chant makes a return in Mexico's World Cup match against Czechia
articles.description: Fans at Mexico's final World Cup group stage match on Wednesday chanted a slur that has previously led to fines and other sanctions against the country's soccer federation.
